description: Convenience wrapper around search_startups pre-tuned for fresh-stealth deal-flow. Returns active stealth startups with their detected tech stack (CDN, email provider, analytics), RDAP domain registration date, and a has_known_emails flag indicating whether at least one founder/team email has been verified. Optional filters: domain_tld (default 'ai,io,so,xyz,security'), with_emails (default true — restrict to startups with at least one known email), founded_after, country, limit. Pro Lite tier and higher only (Free tier 403s). Pro Lite sees redacted emails; Pro tier sees full. The shortest path from 'I want fresh stealth founders to reach out to' to a contactable list — combine with list_startup_team + discover_email to surface the actual addresses. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

domain_tld.description: Comma-separated TLDs. Defaults to 'ai,io,so,xyz,security' (the high-signal AI-native TLDs).

email_provider.description: Optional comma-separated email_provider filter (e.g. 'm365,self_hosted' to find non-Google-Workspace stealth shops).

founded_after.description: Only stealth startups founded on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

with_emails.description: When true (default), only return startups with at least one verified founder/team email.

name: find_stealth_startups
title: Find stealth startups
